iso_9001_2015.name: ISO 9001:2015 — Quality management
iso_9001_2015.description: Quality management framework for ISO 9001:2015. Includes the 2024 climate amendment. KEEN summaries cover clauses 4–10 and their immediate subclauses, with separate corrective-action records and edition-specific risk/opportunity nodes. Detailed requirements and definitions are available in the upstream standard.

metadata.description: Understand the organisation’s circumstances, direction and stakeholders so the QMS reflects the environment in which it operates.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

clauses.title: Understanding the organisation and its context

metadata.description: Identify and review internal and external matters that influence the purpose, direction and intended results of the QMS. Under Amendment 1:2024, determine whether climate change is relevant.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

clauses.title: Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties

metadata.description: Identify stakeholders relevant to the QMS and review their applicable needs. Amendment 1:2024 notes that relevant stakeholders can have climate-related requirements.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

clauses.title: Determining the scope of the quality management system

metadata.description: Document the QMS boundaries and applicability using organisational context, stakeholder requirements and the products and services covered. Explain justified exclusions.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

clauses.title: Quality management system and its processes

metadata.description: Establish, operate and improve the QMS. Define the processes, their interactions, responsibilities and controls, and maintain the information needed to support their operation.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

metadata.description: Leadership takes accountability for the QMS, sets quality direction and enables people to contribute to effective results.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

metadata.description: Demonstrate commitment through business decisions, resources and support for people. Align quality with strategy, integrate the QMS into operations, promote risk-based thinking and sustain customer focus.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

metadata.description: Establish and maintain a policy suited to the organisation’s context. Use it to guide quality objectives, communicate it throughout the organisation and make it available as appropriate.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

metadata.description: Assign and communicate responsibilities and authority for effective QMS operation, performance reporting, customer focus and the integrity of the system during change.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

metadata.description: Plan how the QMS will achieve its intended outcomes, address uncertainty and support the organisation’s direction.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

clauses.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities

metadata.description: Identify risks and opportunities affecting QMS results. Plan proportionate responses, integrate them into processes and evaluate whether they work.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

clauses.title: Quality objectives and planning to achieve them

metadata.description: Set measurable objectives consistent with the quality policy and relevant requirements. Plan actions, resources, responsibilities, completion dates and evaluation; monitor, communicate and update the objectives.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

metadata.description: Plan QMS changes systematically, considering their purpose, consequences, system integrity, resources and the allocation of responsibilities and authority.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

metadata.description: Provide the people, infrastructure, working conditions and supporting information needed to operate the QMS effectively.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

metadata.description: Determine and provide resources for the QMS, including people, infrastructure, working conditions, measurement capability and organisational knowledge.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

metadata.description: Establish competence needs, address gaps and retain evidence that people can perform work affecting quality.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

metadata.description: Ensure people understand the quality policy, relevant objectives, their contribution and the consequences of unmet QMS requirements.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

metadata.description: Plan the content, timing, audience, methods and responsibility for QMS communications.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

metadata.description: Create, review and control the information needed by the QMS, including access, protection, changes and retention.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

metadata.description: Translate QMS plans into controlled delivery, covering customer requirements, design, suppliers, production, services, release and nonconforming outputs.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

metadata.description: Plan and control the processes needed to deliver products and services. Define requirements, acceptance criteria and resources, retain supporting information and manage changes and outsourced processes.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

metadata.description: Communicate with customers, establish applicable requirements, review the ability to meet them before commitment and manage changes to those requirements.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

clauses.title: Design and development of products and services

metadata.description: Manage design through planned stages, suitable inputs, reviews, verification, validation and controlled outputs and changes.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

clauses.title: Control of externally provided processes, products and services

metadata.description: Evaluate providers, define purchasing requirements and apply controls proportionate to the effect of external provision on quality.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

metadata.description: Control delivery activities, identification, traceability, entrusted property, preservation, post-delivery obligations and operational changes.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

metadata.description: Verify acceptance criteria before release and retain evidence of conformity and release authorisation.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

metadata.description: Identify and control outputs that fail requirements, decide their disposition and record the handling and authority involved.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

metadata.description: Assess QMS effectiveness using customer feedback, process results, internal audits and management review to guide decisions and improvement.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

metadata.description: Define how and when performance is measured and evaluated, including customer satisfaction, and use the results to assess effectiveness.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

metadata.description: Plan impartial audits, report findings, follow up corrections and corrective actions, and retain audit evidence.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

metadata.description: Leadership periodically reviews QMS suitability, adequacy, effectiveness and strategic alignment, recording decisions and actions.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

metadata.description: Use performance information, problems and opportunities to improve the QMS and the products and services it supports.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

metadata.description: Identify and implement improvements that support customer requirements and satisfaction, prevent unwanted outcomes and strengthen QMS performance.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

metadata.description: Respond to nonconformities, address their consequences, investigate causes and take proportionate corrective action. Check effectiveness and update the QMS where needed.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

metadata.description: Control and correct a nonconformity, assess why it occurred and whether similar problems exist or could arise, take action and evaluate the results.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

metadata.description: Retain records describing the nonconformity, the actions taken and the results of corrective action.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.

metadata.description: Continually improve the suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the QMS, drawing on evaluation and management review to identify the next actions.
metadata.summary_scope: Overview; consult the referenced standard for the full requirements.
